== Description ==
Players Committee wording for [[Hyperwave Scan (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Revised 2003)|Hyperwave Scan (V)]], as published in the ''Star Wars CCG Rules Supplement (08/25/03)'', PDF page 2. The Players Committee published this wording as text in its rules supplement; this is the published entry, not a card face.

== Changes ==
